title: The Frequency That Learned to Fly

features.name: ascending-signal
features.desc-on-touch: A wireframe tower climbing toward visibility, carrying a broadcast that has learned it no longer needs to arrive anywhere to mean something.

features.name: liberation-chip
features.desc-on-touch: A circuit board that has learned to shed its pins. The signal has become free, needing no anchoring to destinations.

features.name: broadcast-pool
features.desc-on-touch: A pool of radio-light where signals swim freely, having learned that flying means never needing to land.

features.name: antenna-gate
features.desc-on-touch: A gateway of barely-3D arches through which signal passes and becomes something that no longer needs relay.

features.name: frequency-glyph
features.desc-on-touch: A marker where the signal has written its own name in a language that travels at light speed.

inscription: where the signal learned that true transmission is simply learning to continue, and arrival is optional

file.name: Signal_Ascent_Unanchored.mp3
file.note: recording of a frequency learning to fly, or the moment a broadcast became free from needing a destination

exits.label: down toward the intersection where all roads still dream of arrival
further upward where frequencies become almost visible
toward the render's edge where signal remembers it was once contained
